Container.Name: snail-race
Container.Overview: Snail Race: a friendly fitness race. Log cycling, running, rowing or swimming (by hand or from Strava) and race to 100% of your sport's goal.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, profile photos and keys. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 = Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 = Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The exact address you open the app at, e.g. https://snails.example.com (behind a reverse proxy) or http://192.168.1.10:8000. Logins only work at this address.

Config.Name: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Required: a random secret of 32+ characters (e.g. from a password manager, or `openssl rand -base64 32`). Keep it: changing it disconnects everyone's Strava.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: true when a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, nginx) sits in front of the app.

Config.Name: STRAVA_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: From strava.com/settings/api. Leave empty for manual tracking only.

Config.Name: STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional, any random string. Needed for instant Strava updates (requires a public https address).

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Optional. Mail server for password-reset emails. Without it, reset links are printed in the container log.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_RACE_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the race everyone joins.
